title: Run a live match through the operator console
description: An official can move bouts, start a match, pause it, and update scores and penalties during live operation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the operator console for an existing competition
Move a bout to a different mat queue
Start the selected match
Pause the selected match
Update the match score
Update the match penalties
Verify the live match state reflects the score and penalty updates
Verify the bout remains assigned to the selected mat queue
